A little chapter · 12 days together

Somewhere,
we were together.

A few photographs. A hundred little moments.
And people who make an ordinary day feel like a story.

Walk through it ↓
01 / The photographs

Little moments,
kept forever.

Some posed, some random, some that probably made no sense at the time. All ours.

“The best part was never what we did.
It was who I got to do it with.”

12 days · countless memories
02 / The little things

Things worth
remembering.

The moments don't need a date or a caption to matter.

The laughter

All those jokes that somehow got funnier every single time.

The togetherness

Having everyone around, without needing a special reason.

The pictures

Trying to get one perfect photo and ending up with ten favourites.

The chaos

The random plans, the noise, and the little things we'll keep bringing up.

The ordinary

Even doing absolutely nothing felt like the best plan.

The goodbye

12 days went by too quickly. The memories won't.

03 / A note for my favourite people

Until we're all
in one place again.

I don't think I realised how much these days would mean to me until they were over. I miss the noise, the laughs, the random moments, and simply having all of you around. Thank you for making these 12 days feel so special. This isn't a goodbye to the memories — just a little reminder that we made them together. Let's make many more.
With love · Sid
Made with love, for the people who make every place feel like home.
